description: Header file for the Fls_SST25xx flash driver in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, defining function prototypes, version info, and configuration for external flash memory management.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Init
methods.description: Initializes the flash driver with a given configuration.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_GetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the flash driver.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_GetJobResult
methods.description: Gets the result of the last flash job.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_MainFunction
methods.description: Main function to handle flash driver tasks.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Compare
methods.description: Compares flash memory content with a source.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of the flash driver.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Provides version information of the driver.
